title: An Autopsy of a Digital Mind

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Across the four experiments, private judgments grow into questions about meaning and institutional power.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book preserves these connections without claiming that systematic validation is complete.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the preface, then follow a passage that makes you feel recognized.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read its surrounding argument and ask where the proposed explanation stops fitting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The invitation is to enjoy the prose while keeping its authority open to examination.
